picker.title: Choose a folder for the task box
language.label: Language
notice.created_here: Created a starter project in this empty folder.
notice.created_nested: Created a task box in .glidebox/ with a starter project.
pending.title: No task box in this folder yet
pending.body: {folder} has other files but no glidebox task box.
pending.git: It is inside the Git repository {repo}. Your task files will be versioned by that repository; glidebox does not create a second one and does not run Git.
welcome.title: Your project's tasks, in a folder you choose.
welcome.body: Pick a folder. If it already holds a task box, glidebox shows its tasks grouped by area. If the folder is empty, glidebox creates a small starter project in it. In a folder with other files, such as a code repository, glidebox offers to create the task box in {dir}.
box.empty: This task box has no areas or tasks yet.
box.no_project: The project file could not be read, so no tasks are shown. Fix the problem above.
issues.label: Problems in this task box
problem.not_json: This file could not be read as JSON for glidebox: {detail}.
problem.field_unknown: Glidebox does not know this field. Check its spelling, or remove it.
problem.invalid_choice: {value} is not a valid value here. Use one of: {allowed}.
problem.invalid_id: "{id}" is not a valid ID. Use 1–64 letters, digits, '-' or '_'.
problem.wrong_format: Expected "{expected}" but found "{found}". This version of glidebox reads only "{expected}".
problem.ladder_empty: The label ladder needs at least one step.
problem.duplicate_area_id: Another area already uses the ID "{id}".
problem.duplicate_task_id: Another task already uses the ID "{id}".
problem.unknown_area: The area "{area}" does not exist. Add areas/{area}.json or use an existing area ID.
problem.label_not_on_ladder: "{label}" is not a step of this project's ladder ({ladder}).
problem.waiting_on_missing: A waiting task must say what it is waiting on.
problem.task_file_missing: This task folder has no task.json.
problem.folder_not_empty: {path} is not empty, so no task box was created there.
problem.create_failed: Could not create the task box in {path}: {detail}.
